name: 2377-longdecode-mistral7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One GPU, one in-process engine, no collective.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 256 streams, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 3072 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`; every request is exactly 200 prompt tokens and exactly 1600 output tokens (min=max on both), so a request ends at 1800 tokens of context. No per-request `sampling_params` are declared.
purpose: A long-form story generator for 256 concurrent writers, turning short prompts into 1600-token passages on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.7-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.

model: mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1
# MACHINE-LEVEL, not a workload choice. `main`'s tokenizer.json now
# carries `Metaspace.split`, a field tokenizers gained in 0.19; the early-2024 stack this item pins
# has tokenizers 0.15.2 and dies parsing it ("data did not match any variant of untagged enum
# PyPreTokenizerTypeWrapper"). This revision was current when the change was made, and its
# tokenizer.model is byte-identical to main's (sha256 dadfd56d766715c6...), so the vocabulary is
# unchanged. Weights still come from `main` (the safetensors are byte-identical at both revisions).
tokenizer-revision: 26bca36bde8333b5d7f72e9ed20ccda6a618af24
# The same revision as a local directory, because this engine never applies `tokenizer-revision`:
# its get_tokenizer hands the value to AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained as an unknown keyword, which
# drops it, so `main`'s tokenizer.json is loaded and bring-up dies on the parse error above. A
# directory is read as it is: it holds that revision's tokenizer files, and nothing else changes.
# Where it is absent: `hf download mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1 --revision <the revision above>
# --include 'tokenizer*' special_tokens_map.json` (the load generator's tokenizer fetches the same).
tokenizer: ${SYSAGENT_HF_HOME}/hub/models--mistralai--Mistral-7B-v0.1/snapshots/26bca36bde8333b5d7f72e9ed20ccda6a618af24
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enforce-eager: true
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
